```{r}
  rename_with(~ case_when(
    # Handle .x suffix (attn2)
    grepl("^positive_Ripley", .x) & grepl("\\.x$", .x) ~ 
      sub("^positive_", "", sub("_AUC\\.x$", "_positive_AUC_attn2", .x)),
    
    # Handle .y suffix (attn0)  
    grepl("^positive_Ripley", .x) & grepl("\\.y$", .x) ~ 
      sub("^positive_", "", sub("_AUC\\.y$", "_positive_AUC_attn0", .x)),
    
    # Handle no suffix (attn1) - assuming these are the base columns

      sub("^positive_", "", sub("_AUC$", "_positive_AUC_attn1", .x)),
    
    TRUE ~ .x

  relocate(progression,flow,pred,dataset, .after = wsi)%>%
  rename_with(
    ~ ifelse(!grepl("[0-9]$", .x), paste0(.x, "_attn2"), .x),
    .cols = 6:ncol(.)
  )%>%
  rename_with(~ gsub("_([0-9])$", "_attn\\1", .x))
```

```{r plot_n_save}
plot_n_save <- function(plot_data, output_dir, x_lab=c("Low","High"), x_title = "Attention Region", base_name, p_value, test_type){
  
      
      stat_test <- data.frame(
        group1 = x_lab[1],
        group2 = x_lab[2], 
        p = as.character(format(p_value, scientific = TRUE, digits = 2)),
        y.position = max(plot_data$value, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.1,  # Position above the highest point
        test_name = test_type,  # Add test name to the data frame
        p.signif = case_when(
          p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
          p_value < 0.01 ~ "**", 
          p_value < 0.05 ~ "*",
          TRUE ~ "ns"
        )
      )
      
      
      # Create violin + box plot
      p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = x_category, y = value, fill =x_category)) +
        geom_violin(alpha = 0.7, trim = FALSE) +
        geom_boxplot(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.8, outlier.shape = NA) +
        geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.1), alpha = 0.6) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = setNames(c("#4575b4", "#fc8d59"), x_lab)) +
        stat_pvalue_manual(
          stat_test, 
          label = "{test_name}: p = {p}",  # Include test name and p-value
          tip.length = 0.02,
          bracket.size = 0.6,
          size = 3.5,
          xmin = "group1", 
          xmax = "group2",
        inherit.aes = F
        ) +
        labs(
          title = base_name,
          # subtitle = paste0("p-value: ", sprintf("%.4f", p_value), 
          #                  " (", test_type, ")"),
          x = x_title,
          y = "Value"
        ) +
        theme_minimal() +
        theme(
          plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12),
          axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
          axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
          legend.position = "none",
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
        )
      
      # Save plot
      plot_filename <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(base_name, ".pdf"))
      ggsave(plot_filename, p, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
      
}
```

```{r analyze_attention_pairs}
analyze_attention_pairs <- function(data, p_threshold = 0.05, output_dir = "plots") {
  
  # Create output directory if it doesn't exist
  if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
    dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  }
  
  # Get column names
  all_cols <- names(data)
  
  # Find columns ending with attn0 and attn1
  attn0_cols <- grep("attn0$", all_cols, value = TRUE)
  attn1_cols <- grep("attn1$", all_cols, value = TRUE)
  
  # Create pairs by matching base names
  base_names_0 <- gsub("attn0$", "", attn0_cols)
  base_names_1 <- gsub("attn1$", "", attn1_cols)
  
  # Find common base names (metrics that have both attn0 and attn1)
  common_bases <- intersect(base_names_0, base_names_1)
  
  if (length(common_bases) == 0) {
    stop("No matching attention pairs found. Check column naming convention.")
  }
  
  cat("Found", length(common_bases), "attention pairs to analyze\n")
  
  # Initialize results storage
  results <- data.frame(
    metric = character(),
    p_value = numeric(),
    test_type = character(),
    significant = logical(),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  # Process each pair
  for (base_name in common_bases) {
    
    col_attn0 <- paste0(base_name, "attn0")
    col_attn1 <- paste0(base_name, "attn1")
    
    # cat("Processing:", base_name, "\n")
    
    # Extract data for current pair
    attn0_data <- data[[col_attn0]]
    attn1_data <- data[[col_attn1]]
    
    # Remove NA values
    valid_indices <- !is.na(attn0_data) & !is.na(attn1_data) & attn0_data != 0 & attn1_data != 0
    attn0_clean <- attn0_data[valid_indices]
    attn1_clean <- attn1_data[valid_indices]
    
    if (length(attn0_clean) < 3 || length(attn1_clean) < 3) {
      cat("  Skipping", base_name, "- insufficient data\n")
      next
    }
    
    # Perform normality tests
    shapiro_attn0 <- tryCatch(shapiro.test(attn0_clean), error = function(e) NULL)
    shapiro_attn1 <- tryCatch(shapiro.test(attn1_clean), error = function(e) NULL)
    
    # Decide on test type
    if (!is.null(shapiro_attn0) && !is.null(shapiro_attn1) && 
        shapiro_attn0$p.value > 0.05 && shapiro_attn1$p.value > 0.05) {
      # Both normal - use paired t-test
      test_result <- tryCatch(
        t.test(attn0_clean, attn1_clean, paired = TRUE),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )
      test_type <- "Paired t-test"
      # Effect size (Cohen's d for paired samples)
      effect_size <- if (!is.null(test_result)) {
        diff_values <- attn0_clean - attn1_clean
        mean(diff_values) / sd(diff_values)
      } else NA
    } else {
      # Non-parametric - use Wilcoxon signed-rank test
      test_result <- tryCatch(
        wilcox.test(attn0_clean, attn1_clean, paired = TRUE),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )
      test_type <- "Wilcoxon"
      # Effect size (r = Z / sqrt(N))
      effect_size <- if (!is.null(test_result) && !is.null(test_result$statistic)) {
        # Approximation for effect size
        abs(qnorm(test_result$p.value/2)) / sqrt(length(attn0_clean))
      } else NA
    }
    
    if (is.null(test_result)) {
      cat("  Test failed for", base_name, "\n")
      next
    }
    
    significant_check <- ifelse(test_result$p.value < p_threshold,1,0)
    
    results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
      metric = base_name,
      p_value = test_result$p.value,
      test_type = test_type,
      effect_size = effect_size,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
      significant = significant_check
    ))
    
    # cat("  p-value:", sprintf("%.6f", test_result$p.value), 
    #     ifelse(is_significant, "(significant)", "(not significant)"), "\n")
    
    # Generate plot if significant
    if ( !is.na(test_result$p.value) & significant_check ==1) {
      
      # Prepare data for plotting
      plot_data <- data.frame(
        value = c(attn0_clean, attn1_clean),
        x_category = factor(rep(c("Low", "High"), 
                              c(length(attn0_clean), length(attn1_clean))), levels = c("Low", "High")),
        id = rep(1:length(attn0_clean), 2)  # for paired data visualization
      )
      plot_n_save(plot_data, output_dir,x_title = "Attention Region" , x_lab=c("Low", "High"), base_name, test_result$p.value, test_type)

    }
  }
  
  # Summary statistics
  cat("\n=== ANALYSIS SUMMARY ===\n")
  cat("Total metrics analyzed:", nrow(results), "\n")
  cat("Significant results:", sum(results$significant), "\n")
  cat("Non-significant results:", sum(!results$significant), "\n")
  
  
  # Save results to CSV
  results_filename <- file.path(output_dir, "statistical_results.csv")
  write.csv(results, results_filename, row.names = FALSE)
  cat("\nResults saved to:", results_filename, "\n")
  
  # return(results)
}
```

```{r analyze_intergroup}
analyze_intergroup <- function(data, attn = 1, exp = "pred", p_threshold = 0.05, output_dir = "plots") {
  
  # Create output directory if it doesn't exist
  if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
    dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  }
  
  # Get column names
  all_cols <- colnames(data)[grepl(paste0(attn, "$"), colnames(data))]
  
  # Initialize results storage
  results <- data.frame(
    metric = character(),
    p_value = numeric(),
    test_type = character(),
    significant = logical(),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  # Process each pair
  for (base_name in all_cols) {
    data_1 <- data%>%
      filter( !!sym(exp) == 1 )%>%
      pull(!!sym(base_name))
    
    data_0 <- data%>%
      filter( !!sym(exp) == 0 )%>%
      pull(!!sym(base_name))
    

    
    # Remove NA values
  data_1_clean <- data_1[!is.na(data_1) & data_1 != 0]
  data_0_clean <- data_0[!is.na(data_0) & data_0 != 0]
    
    
    
    if (length(data_1_clean) < 3 || length(data_0_clean) < 3) {
      cat("  Skipping", base_name, "- insufficient data\n")
      next
    }
    
    # Perform normality tests
    shapiro_0 <- tryCatch(shapiro.test(data_0_clean), error = function(e) NULL)
    shapiro_1 <- tryCatch(shapiro.test(data_1_clean), error = function(e) NULL)
    
    # Decide on test type
    if (!is.null(shapiro_0) && !is.null(shapiro_1) && 
        shapiro_0$p.value > 0.05 && shapiro_1$p.value > 0.05) {
      # Both normal - use paired t-test
      test_result <- tryCatch(
        t.test(data_0_clean, data_1_clean, var.equal = FALSE),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )
      test_type <- "t-test"
    } else {
      # Non-parametric - use Wilcoxon signed-rank test
      test_result <- tryCatch(
        wilcox.test(data_0_clean, data_1_clean),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )
      test_type <- "Mann-Whitney U"
    }
    
    if (is.null(test_result)) {
      cat("  Test failed for", base_name, "\n")
      next
    }else{
      pval <- test_result$p.value
    }
    
    results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
      metric = base_name,
      p_value = pval,
      test_type = test_type,
      significant = ifelse(pval < p_threshold, 1,0),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
    
    # Generate plot if significant
    if (!is.na(pval) & pval < p_threshold ) {
      if(exp == "progression"){
             x_lab = c("NCO", "CO")
             x_title = "Patient Outcome"
               }else{
                 x_lab = c("Low", "High")
                 x_title = "DNA Content"}
      
      # Prepare data for plotting
      plot_data <- data.frame(
        value = c(data_0_clean, data_1_clean),
        x_category = factor(rep(x_lab, 
                              c(length(data_0_clean), length(data_1_clean))),
                    levels = x_lab)
      )
      plot_n_save(plot_data, output_dir,x_title = x_title , x_lab=x_lab, base_name, pval, test_type)

    }
  }
  
  # Summary statistics
  cat("\n=== ANALYSIS SUMMARY ===\n")
  cat("Total metrics analyzed:", nrow(results), "\n")
  cat("Significant results:", sum(results$significant), "\n")
  cat("Non-significant results:", sum(!results$significant), "\n")
  
  
  # Save results to CSV
  results_filename <- file.path(output_dir, "statistical_results.csv")
  write.csv(results, results_filename, row.names = FALSE)
  cat("\nResults saved to:", results_filename, "\n")
  
  return(results)
}
```

```{r}
results_1_alt <- data_frame(metric_name = character())
results_w_alt <- data_frame(metric_name = character())

for(dataset in c("whole", "MDA", "NU")){
  intraslide <- read.csv(file.path(output_dir, dataset, "attn_0_1", "statistical_results.csv")) %>% 
    filter(significant == 1)
  interslide_1 <- read.csv(file.path(output_dir, dataset, "aneuploid_diploid", "attn1", "statistical_results.csv")) %>% 
    filter(significant == 1)
  interslide_w <- read.csv(file.path(output_dir, dataset, "aneuploid_diploid", "wholeSlide", "statistical_results.csv")) %>% 
    filter(significant == 1)
  
  intraslide$metric_name <- sub("_[^_]*$", "", intraslide$metric)
  interslide_1$metric_name <- sub("_[^_]*$", "", interslide_1$metric)
  interslide_w$metric_name <- sub("_[^_]*$", "", interslide_w$metric)
  
  # Cleaner approach using setNames()
  common_cols_1 <- setNames(
    data.frame(
      metric_name = intersect(intraslide$metric_name, interslide_1$metric_name),
      significant = 1
    ),
    c("metric_name", paste0("significant_", dataset))
  )
  
  common_cols_w <- setNames(
    data.frame(
      metric_name = intersect(intraslide$metric_name, interslide_w$metric_name),
      significant = 1
    ),
    c("metric_name", paste0("significant_", dataset))
  )
  results_1_alt <- full_join(common_cols_1,results_1_alt,  by = "metric_name")%>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ replace_na(., 0)))
  results_w_alt <- full_join(common_cols_w,results_w_alt,  by = "metric_name")%>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ replace_na(., 0)))
}
write.csv(results_1_alt,file.path(output_dir, "significant_aneuploid_metrics_attn1.csv"),row.names = F)
```

```{r }
# install.packages("ggbreak")

plot_n_save_specific <- function(plot_data, output_dir, x_lab=c("Low","High"), x_title = "Attention Region", base_name, p_value, test_type, custom_break = NULL){
  
      
      stat_test <- data.frame(
        group1 = x_lab[1],
        group2 = x_lab[2], 
        p = case_when(
          p_value < 0.0001 ~ "<.0001",
          p_value < 0.001 ~ "<.001",
          TRUE ~ paste("=",sub("^0\\.", ".", sprintf("%.3f", p_value))) 
      ),
        y.position = max(plot_data$value, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.1,  # Position above the highest point
        test_name = test_type,  # Add test name to the data frame
        p.signif = case_when(
          p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
          p_value < 0.01 ~ "**", 
          p_value < 0.05 ~ "*",
          TRUE ~ "ns"
        )
      )
      
      
      # Create violin + box plot
      p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = x_category, y = value, fill =x_category)) +
        geom_violin(alpha = 0.7, trim = FALSE,size = 0.1) +
        geom_boxplot(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.8, outlier.shape = NA,size = 0.1) +
        geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.3), alpha = 0.6,size = 0.05) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = setNames(c("#4575b4", "#fc8d59"), x_lab)) +
        stat_pvalue_manual(
          stat_test, 
          label = "P {p}", 
          tip.length = 0.02,
          bracket.size = 0.2,
          size = 2,
          xmin = "group1", 
          xmax = "group2",
        inherit.aes = F
        ) +
        labs(
          title = base_name,
          # subtitle = paste0("p-value: ", sprintf("%.4f", p_value), 
          #                  " (", test_type, ")"),
          x = x_title,
          y = "Value"
        ) +
        theme_minimal() +
          theme(
            plot.title = element_text(size = 6, face = "bold"),
            axis.title = element_text(size = 5),
            axis.text = element_text(size =5 ),
            legend.position = "none",
            panel.grid.major = element_blank(),  # Remove major grid lines
            panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),  # Remove minor grid lines
            axis.line = element_line(color = "black", size = 0.4)  # Add axis lines
          )
        # scale_y_break(custom_break)
      
      # Save plot
      return(p)
}
```

```{r single plor functions for figures }
single_intra_wsi <- function(data,base_name,custom_break=NULL){
  data <- merged_df%>%filter(pred ==1)
    col_attn0 <- paste0(base_name, "attn0")
    col_attn1 <- paste0(base_name, "attn1")
    
    # cat("Processing:", base_name, "\n")
    
    # Extract data for current pair
    attn0_data <- data[[col_attn0]]
    attn1_data <- data[[col_attn1]]
    
    # Remove NA values
    valid_indices <- !is.na(attn0_data) & !is.na(attn1_data) & attn0_data != 0 & attn1_data != 0
    attn0_clean <- attn0_data[valid_indices]
    attn1_clean <- attn1_data[valid_indices]
      
    if (length(attn0_clean) < 3 || length(attn1_clean) < 3) {
      cat("  Skipping", base_name, "- insufficient data\n")
      next
    }
    
    # Perform normality tests
    shapiro_attn0 <- tryCatch(shapiro.test(attn0_clean), error = function(e) NULL)
    shapiro_attn1 <- tryCatch(shapiro.test(attn1_clean), error = function(e) NULL)
    
    # Decide on test type
    if (!is.null(shapiro_attn0) && !is.null(shapiro_attn1) && 
        shapiro_attn0$p.value > 0.05 && shapiro_attn1$p.value > 0.05) {
      # Both normal - use paired t-test
      test_result <- tryCatch(
        t.test(attn0_clean, attn1_clean, paired = TRUE),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )
      test_type <- "Paired t-test"
      # Effect size (Cohen's d for paired samples)
      effect_size <- if (!is.null(test_result)) {
        diff_values <- attn0_clean - attn1_clean
        mean(diff_values) / sd(diff_values)
      } else NA
    } else {
      # Non-parametric - use Wilcoxon signed-rank test
      test_result <- tryCatch(
        wilcox.test(attn0_clean, attn1_clean, paired = TRUE),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )
      test_type <- "Wilcoxon"
      # Effect size (r = Z / sqrt(N))
      effect_size <- if (!is.null(test_result) && !is.null(test_result$statistic)) {
        # Approximation for effect size
        abs(qnorm(test_result$p.value/2)) / sqrt(length(attn0_clean))
      } else NA
    }
    
    if (is.null(test_result)) {
      cat("  Test failed for", base_name, "\n")
      next
    }
    
  
    
    # cat("  p-value:", sprintf("%.6f", test_result$p.value), 
    #     ifelse(is_significant, "(significant)", "(not significant)"), "\n")
    
    # Generate plot if significant
      
      # Prepare data for plotting
      plot_data <- data.frame(
        value = c(attn0_clean, attn1_clean),
        x_category = factor(rep(c("Low", "High"), 
                              c(length(attn0_clean), length(attn1_clean))), levels = c("Low", "High")),
        id = rep(1:length(attn0_clean), 2)  # for paired data visualization
      )
      
       p<- plot_n_save_specific(plot_data, output_dir,x_title = "Attention Region" , x_lab=c("Low", "High"), base_name, test_result$p.value, test_type, custom_break = custom_break )
       return(p)
}

single_inter_wsi <- function(data, base_name,attn = 1, exp = "pred",custom_break=NULL){
  
  p_threshold = 0.05
  data_1 <- data%>%
    filter( !!sym(exp) == 1 )%>%
    pull(!!sym(base_name))
  
  data_0 <- data%>%
    filter( !!sym(exp) == 0 )%>%
    pull(!!sym(base_name))
  
  
  # Remove NA values
  data_1_clean <- data_1[!is.na(data_1) & data_1 != 0]
  data_0_clean <- data_0[!is.na(data_0) & data_0 != 0]
  
  
  if (length(data_1_clean) < 3 || length(data_0_clean) < 3) {
    cat("  Skipping", base_name, "- insufficient data\n")
    next
  }
  
  # Perform normality tests
  shapiro_0 <- tryCatch(shapiro.test(data_0_clean), error = function(e) NULL)
  shapiro_1 <- tryCatch(shapiro.test(data_1_clean), error = function(e) NULL)
  
  # Decide on test type
  if (!is.null(shapiro_0) && !is.null(shapiro_1) && 
      shapiro_0$p.value > 0.05 && shapiro_1$p.value > 0.05) {
    # Both normal - use paired t-test
    test_result <- tryCatch(
      t.test(data_0_clean, data_1_clean, var.equal = FALSE),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    test_type <- "t-test"
  } else {
    # Non-parametric - use Wilcoxon signed-rank test
    test_result <- tryCatch(
      wilcox.test(data_0_clean, data_1_clean),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    test_type <- "Mann-Whitney U"
  }
  
  if (is.null(test_result)) {
    cat("  Test failed for", base_name, "\n")
    next
  }else{
    pval <- test_result$p.value
  }
  
  
  # Generate plot if significant
  if (!is.na(pval) & pval < p_threshold ) {
    if(exp == "progression"){
           x_lab = c("NCO", "CO")
           x_title = "Patient Outcome"
             }else{
               x_lab = c("Low", "High")
               x_title = "DNA Content"}
    
    # Prepare data for plotting
    plot_data <- data.frame(
      value = c(data_0_clean, data_1_clean),
      x_category = factor(rep(x_lab, 
                            c(length(data_0_clean), length(data_1_clean))),
                  levels = x_lab)
    )
    p <- plot_n_save_specific(plot_data, output_dir,x_title = x_title , x_lab=x_lab, base_name, pval, test_type, custom_break = custom_break)

  }

  return(p)
}
```
